stories.headline: Andorra and San Marino sign association agreements with the EU
stories.summary: Andorra and San Marino have each signed an association agreement with the European Union. The agreement organises the two small states' participation in the single market. It was signed on 19 October 2026, after the Council of the EU authorised the signing in July.

stories.headline: Equatorial Guinea widens a malaria programme to the mainland
stories.summary: Equatorial Guinea has announced that it will expand its programme against malaria to the mainland and to Annobón. The programme has already heavily reduced malaria cases on Bioko Island.

stories.headline: A touch from a healthy neighbour revives dying coral
stories.summary: Coral that had turned white and was close to dying regained its health within seven weeks when it was left in contact with a healthy fragment of the same animal. In the laboratory experiment each pair held one healthy fragment and one bleached fragment from the same coral animal. The bleached fragments that were kept apart died.

questions.lead: Two of Europe's smallest states have finished a long negotiation with the European Union and signed agreements tying them more closely to its economy.

questions.lead: Andorra and San Marino have each signed an association agreement with the European Union, which the Council of the EU authorised in July 2026.

questions.lead: A country in central Africa says a malaria programme that has already cut cases sharply on one of its islands will now be extended to the mainland.
questions.prompt: Which country announced that it would expand the programme?

questions.lead: In a laboratory experiment, coral fragments that had turned white and were close to dying were left in contact with a healthy fragment from the same coral animal.
questions.prompt: How long did those bleached fragments take to regain their health?

questions.lead: In the coral experiment each pair held one healthy fragment and one bleached fragment from the same animal. Some pairs were left touching, while the others were kept apart.
questions.prompt: What became of the bleached fragments that were kept apart?
options: They regained their colour but stayed weak
